content.short: Cat Gold Miner is a gold mining simulation game on TON where players manage a feline workforce.
content.description: Cat Gold Miner is a popular and addictive gold mining simulation game built as a Telegram Mini App on the TON blockchain. Players take on the role of a mine manager, overseeing a specialized feline workforce to extract gold and expand their mining operations. The game features Play-to-Earn mechanics where players can earn $wCATGM tokens and participate in the project's growing economy. Cat Gold Miner combines the depth of traditional management sims with the benefits of digital asset ownership, providing a highly rewarding experience for its community.
content.meta: Manage your cat mining empire in Cat Gold Miner on TON. Play and earn on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
